news.title: Fed votes to hold rates steady, notes 'uncertain' impacts from Iran war
news.description: The Federal Reserve on Wednesday released its decision in interest rates.

news.title: Trump waives U.S. shipping law for 60 days to steady oil market
news.description: The Trump administration "remains committed to continuing to strengthen our critical supply chains" amid the Iran war, press secretary Karoline Leavitt said.

news.title: Dow tumbles 600 points to session low as inflation fears hurt stocks: Live updates
news.description: The three major averages posted back-to-back gains on Tuesday, even as oil prices ended the session higher. Traders are now awaiting the Fed's policy decision.
